title: How to Sell Ebooks from Kenya: A Step-by-Step Deployment Guide
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: Selling digital products from Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, or Zimbabwe is fully operational with sovereign commerce infrastructure that has no geographic restrictions.

imageCaption: The blockchain has no geographic restrictions — a wallet in Lagos processes identically to one in London.

content.text: You’re a creator in Kenya. You’ve written an ebook. You’re ready to sell it globally. But Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad don’t work here. Conventional platforms reject your geography. This guide solves that. You’ll deploy a sovereign [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-works|digital]] commerce stack. No platforms. No subscriptions. No geographic restrictions. Your infrastructure runs on GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and crypto payments. You own it. You control it. You scale it. By the end of this guide, you’ll have a fully operational online store. Instant product delivery. Automatic payment verification. Full data ownership. Built for Kenya. Works anywhere.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms fail because they depend on centralized payment networks. Stripe and PayPal require banking systems they trust. In Kenya, those systems are restricted or absent. This infrastructure bypasses them. It uses blockchain-based payments. USDT on Tron settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. No banks. No intermediaries. No geographic restrictions. Your store runs on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Free. Immutable. Globally accessible. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Order storage is in Supabase or Google Sheets. File delivery is via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Every component is decentralized. Every component is under your control. This isn’t a workaround. It’s base-layer infrastructure. Built for creators Stripe locked out.
What You Need Before You Deploy

You need three things. First, your digital product. Ebook, course, template—whatever you’re selling. Second, a crypto wallet. Binance P2P supports Kenyan shillings. Use it to convert local currency to USDT or another stablecoin. Third, a domain name. Optional but recommended. Points to your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site. Makes your store look professional. No technical skills required. The stack is pre-configured. You fill in your details. Deploy in 48 hours. The Sovereign [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-start-selling-digital-products-crypto-complete|How to]]er Stack ($97) includes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments. Loaded with three products. 30-day support. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) adds Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. Five products loaded. End-to-end tested. Choose the stack that fits your needs. Both give you infrastructure sovereignty.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Payment processing is handled by NOWPayments. Supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. 0.5% fee. No KYC. No buyer account required. Automatic webhook fires the moment payment confirms on-chain. Recommended networks: BSC, Solana, TRON. Under $0.10 per transaction. Delivery is automated. Buyer pays. Webhook triggers. File is sent from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Instant. Secure. No manual intervention. Order storage is in Supabase or Google Sheets. Every transaction is logged. Every file delivery is tracked. You own the data. You control the pipeline. No platform has access. No platform can shut you down. This is your infrastructure. Built to last.
USDT on Tron settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. Instant global payments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your stack. Test it. Go live. Deployment takes 48 hours. Test every component. Payment processing. File delivery. Order logging. Use testnet crypto for trials. Once confirmed, flip the switch. Your store is live. Process your first transaction. Buyer pays in USDT on Tron. Payment confirms in under 60 seconds. File is delivered instantly. Order is logged in Supabase or Google Sheets. You’ve sold your first ebook. Globally. Without Stripe. Without PayPal. Without restrictions. This is what infrastructure sovereignty looks like. You’re not renting. You’re owning.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Your stack is live. Now scale it. Add more products. Expand to new markets. The infrastructure handles it. No limits. No additional fees. Use Binance P2P to convert crypto earnings back to Kenyan shillings. Reinvest in your business. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) includes complete docs for all five stacks. Full source code. NOWPayments integration guide. Scaling playbook. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all six blueprints plus all seven templates. Instant download. Worth $348 separately. Everything you need to build, deploy, and scale. No platform can keep up. This is your infrastructure. Built for growth.

Convert earnings back to naira, cedis, or shillings. This is how you sell globally. Without restrictions.

Whether you’re selling ebooks in Zimbabwe or courses in the Philippines, this stack removes geographic barriers. Crypto payments. Decentralized hosting. Automated delivery. Built for the people Stripe locked out. Not a workaround. Base-layer infrastructure. Own your stack. Own your future.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter ($97) or Edge Commerce ($197). Prepare your digital product. Set up a crypto wallet. Use Binance P2P to convert Kenyan shillings to USDT. Deploy your stack on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Configure NOWPayments for crypto processing. Test payment processing with testnet crypto. Automate file delivery from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Log orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. Test every component. Go live. Process your first transaction. Scale by adding more products. Convert earnings back to local currency via Binance P2P. Upgrade to the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all blueprints and templates. Available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Own your infrastructure.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?

Yes. The stack is pre-configured. You fill in your details. Deploy in 48 hours. No coding required. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) includes 30-day support. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes end-to-end testing. Both are designed for non-technical creators.
What cryptocurrencies should I accept?

Accept USDT on Tron for low fees and fast settlement. Under $0.10 per transaction. Confirms in under 60 seconds. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommend BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees. No KYC. No buyer account required.
How do I convert crypto earnings to local currency?

Use Binance P2P. Supports Kenyan shillings, naira, cedis, and Pakistani rupees. Convert USDT or other crypto back to local currency. Instant. Secure. No bank required. Reinvest in your business. Scale your operations.
Can I sell more than ebooks?

Yes. The stack supports any digital product. Courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software. Add as many products as you want. The infrastructure scales with you. No limits. No additional fees. Full control.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments has 99.9% uptime. If it fails, your stack still runs. Orders are logged in Supabase or Google Sheets. File delivery continues from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. You own the infrastructure. No single point of failure. Built to last.
